name: timestral-vs-rte day-ahead backtest
target: French national electricity consumption (MW), hourly mean of RTE eco2mix definitive data

data.source: RTE eco2mix via ODRE open data (dataset eco2mix-national-cons-def)

task.description: For each test day D (UTC), forecast the 24 hourly values of D using only data observed up to D-1 12:00 UTC, about when RTE's own day-ahead (J-1) forecast is available.

timestral_calendar.covariates: known future calendar features: hour of day (sin, cos), day of week (sin, cos), weekend flag

models.rte_j1: RTE's official day-ahead forecast (prevision_j1), hourly mean, as published
models.naive_weekly: value at the same hour 7 days earlier
models.naive_2day: value at the same hour 2 days earlier (the latest same-hour value available at the cutoff)

metrics.primary: MAE in MW over all scored hours
secondary: coverage of the 10-90% quantile interval (Timestral only)
share of days where the model beats rte_j1 on daily MAE

rules: This file is committed before the first backtest run; results record its SHA-256.
No tuning on the test window. The checkpoint and context length were chosen before running.
Context windows never include data after the cutoff (checked by tests/test_leakage.py).
